title: Integration mixing metrics

batch_key.note: obs column carrying the batch/library label (iLISI/kBET/ASW-batch)

label_key.note: obs column with cell-type/ground-truth labels (enables cLISI/ARI/NMI/ASW-label); empty = those metrics N/A

embedding_key.note: obsm key to score; empty auto-resolves X_pca_melody -> X_pca_harmony -> X_emb -> X_pca, else computes PCA

normalize.note: normalize_total + log1p before PCA when computing an embedding from raw counts

n_pcs.note: PCs when an embedding must be computed

background: Computes the standard single-cell integration-benchmark metrics from an embedding + a batch/label vector: iLISI (batch mixing) and cLISI (cell-type separation) as the perplexity-calibrated inverse-Simpson neighbourhood diversity; kBET acceptance (per-neighbourhood chi-squared of local vs global batch frequency); ARI and NMI of a KMeans(k=#labels) clustering vs the ground-truth labels; and batch/label silhouette widths. LISI and kBET are clean-room reimplementations from the published definitions (no GPL harmonypy/kBET code); ARI/NMI/silhouette use scikit-learn (BSD). Batch metrics need >=2 batches; label-dependent metrics report N/A without a label key. The graded metric the integration-benchmark paper class prints, that Selom's integration skill could not previously read back.

catalog.name: Integration mixing metrics
catalog.summary: Score how well a batch-correction / integration mixed the batches while preserving cell-type structure: iLISI, cLISI, kBET, ARI, NMI and silhouette computed from an embedding + a batch (and optional cell-type) label. The numbers the integration-benchmark papers print. Chains after Melody integration (reads the corrected embedding) or runs standalone (computes PCA). LISI/kBET are clean-room, no GPL dependency.
